features.quote: Caves and installations can be discerned in the western slope

notes: f2: caves on the tell's western slope, not called burial caves. 'There are no walls or building remains' inside the tell is not an absence of pools, pits or graves. Kh. Bel'ameh (S103) is named only as a landmark; no feature of it is described here. Springs are not pools. Entry is Zertal 1992 = English ed. Vol. 1 (2004), read from the packet's OCR excerpt (Internet Archive loan); no plan image in the packet.
